comment: The deck editor's rules for Core 2 (docs/design/11 WP-18), as the web keeps them in src/content/deckRules.js and src/model/deckRules.js at the pinned sha b8cfe4fac. defaults: every value is a default; a profile's stored settings override them (deckEditBounds and friends). singleCopy / where / unlimitedCardIds / equipmentEligibility: the class-string copy limit, the doors the editor opens from, the plain basics a run with no equipment may add, and the equipment gate. editState: everything an editor session can change (cancel puts all of it back). movement: the effect op of a card whose only effect is movement (a range-off run cannot add it). cardDomain: the tag domain whose ids are the card schools. colorlessClass, classTagPrefix, typeGroup, unlimitedMode: the vocabulary the copy limit reads from the profile. inventedFields: the only fields a card the editor adds may carry.
